headline: Ether Long-To-Short Ratio Rose 0.14 To 2.42 Over 24 Hours
narrative: Ether's long-to-short ratio rose to 2.42, up 0.14 over 24 hours and 0.52 over seven days. The reading is the 96.8th percentile of the last 30 days, in a span that runs from 1.0 to 2.65. The ratio compares long positioning with short positioning, so 2.42 means longs outweigh shorts by 2.42 to 1, and the rise means long leverage was added through the day.
author: jordan
